article.title: OptimizeGEO整合AI廣告、商品推薦情報與待批准的執行建議
article.title_en: OptimizeGEO combines AI ad insights, shopping intelligence and approval-based execution
article.summary: 11月3日公告推出Integrated Demand Engine，涵蓋AI Ads Insights等三項能力。
article.summary_en: The November 3 announcement introduces Integrated Demand Engine with three capabilities.
highlights: AI Ads Insights整合ChatGPT付費廣告與自然可見度資訊。
商品情報細至SKU；Execution Agents的流程保留人手批准。
highlights_en: AI Ads Insights brings together paid ChatGPT ad and organic visibility information.
Shopping intelligence works at SKU level; execution workflows retain human approval.
article.why: 品牌可比較商品在AI推薦中的描述、零售商去向及付費曝光，決定先修正哪些資料。
article.why_en: Brands can compare product descriptions, retail destinations and paid visibility to prioritize data fixes.
article.next_step: 先抽查一組重要商品，要求供應商展示來源、抽樣方式與批准流程。
article.next_step_en: Audit priority products and ask the vendor to demonstrate sources, sampling and approval controls.
article.detail: GEO是協助品牌改善在生成式AI搜尋中呈現方式的工作。按公司介紹，AI Ads Insights觀察廣告品牌、相關提示及素材；AI Shopping Intelligence比較個別商品、競品及零售商；Execution Agents可檢查網站並生成程式碼或內容。這些屬供應商功能描述，公告未證明可完整覆蓋所有AI答案。本報不沿用其研究比例或市場預測，也不將執行建議視為已批准上線。
article.detail_en: GEO concerns how brands appear in generative search. The vendor describes ad observation, product-level comparisons and agents generating site code or content. This does not establish exhaustive AI-answer coverage. Research percentages and market forecasts are omitted; proposed changes still need approval.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
